title: Magazine p. 41: Gemini-5 rendezvous evaluation pod photos and S65-45672 blowup
description: Photocopied magazine page of numbered images illustrating, per its caption, "the problem of identifying photographs of objects in the glare of space." Images include an artist's rendition of the rendezvous evaluation pod after jettison from the Gemini adaptor section, a grainy oblong blob, the "Actual Gemini-5 photo (blowup of S65-45672) of the pod at a range of several hundred feet," and "Space engineers at Cape Kennedy prepare the 'rendezvous evaluation pod' sub-satellite for a joint flight with the Gemini-5 spacecraft in 1965." A caption also discusses a Scott Carpenter Mercury-7 balloon photo, and a handwritten note reads "see plate 21 for full photo blowup."
